author: Avetetsuya Studios
title: Hiring freelance artists for character, background, and game art
content: HIRING LOOKING FOR FREELANCE ARTISTS. Avetetsuya Studios saat ini membuka kesempatan bagi freelance artist untuk berkolaborasi dalam berbagai proyek mendatang. Kami mencari artist yang memiliki kemampuan dalam: Character Design & Illustration, Character Sprites, Background & Environment Art, Webtoon / Comic Artwork, Game & Digital Art Assets. Cara Melamar: kirimkan portofolio dan perkenalan singkat ke avetetsuyastudios@gmail.com Subject: Freelance Artist Application – [Nama Anda]. Sertakan jenis artwork, art style, ketersediaan, dan rate freelance.

author: valkyriexssss
title: Looking for OC photocard / NSO / pixel artists
content: Looking for artists that can draw my OC in a photocard style!! I'm also looking for someone who can do the NSO(Needy Streamer Overload) art style, or artists who can do pixel art/pixelated artstyles! it's probably gonna be pricey, but whatever.. Mainly looking for someone who can reserve a slot for me, bc I'm still saving up. Styles: NSO, pixel art, pop art, vibrant/funky, Persona vibes. If you don't have any of these artstyles, you can shoot your shot and show me some of ur samples!! Contact via Facebook comments/DM on the group post.
